notes.title: Last Call for the Demo before launch! [event complete]
notes.content: [p]Hey Aces![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t yet checked out the demo for Battle Suit Aces, now is your LAST CHANCE before the game’s upcoming launch on October 7th. You can play the demo starting today through Monday, September 22nd as part of the Six One Indie showcase.[/p][previewyoutube="ZhKcqp1oxG4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3408070/Battle_Suit_Aces_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]The dynamic demo takes you through the first little bit of the game, teaching basic card-battling mechanics and tugging at your heartstrings with our fully-voiced, wonderful cast of mecha-piloting misfits.[/p][p][/p][p]Play the demo now and get excited for the full PC, PS5, and Nintendo Switch release on October 7th, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're not sure if a story-driven card-battler RPG is for you, give the demo a try! We think you'll fall in love.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/413ec99e79db7d07fe180cfffeff0adea3c549a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you get a chance to play the demo, we’d very much like to hear what you think. [b]Please leave a review here on Steam![/b] And if you love it and want to tell your friends about it, that would mean a ton to us. You can also join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/trinketstudios"]Discord[/url] where you’ll get some behind-the-scenes looks at what the team is working on.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the Bridge! ✨[/p]

notes.title: Coming October 7th!
notes.content: [p]The game has made enormous strides in the last couple months, so we're thrilled to announce that it's coming soon to your computer (and console) October 7th![/p][p][/p][p]I am beaming with pride. This is our best game by far. Just gotta tweak a few more cards and battles, add a bunch more sound effects, and listen to the credits song another thousand times.[/p][previewyoutube="ZhKcqp1oxG4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We can't wait for you to start exploring another enormous world from our team. And meeting so, so many charming, goofy, and kind characters.[/p][p][/p][p]For good measure, here's a sporty Suit from one of the Starball athletes you can recruit, Nishi:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/b5bfe28ae392f2a85028a5f9fc62f43c27856b86.png"][/img][/p][p]Here’s another sneak peak at some of the many drones to consider adding to your deck. They’re unpiloted, making them a bit more expendable than Battle Suits, but can be very valuable for supplying and reinforcing the rest of your team.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/3bd3c884253b9f92b9c81fb9c568bf09fa469786.png"][/img][/p][p]As always, don't forget to wishlist Battle Suit Aces and [url="http://discord.gg/trinketstudios"]join us on Discord[/url]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870530/Battle_Suit_Aces/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Prepare to deploy, Aces![/p][p]-TrinketTom[/p]

notes.title: Part anime game, part deckbuilder, Battle Suit Aces is finally available to try
notes.content:
The indie deckbuilder is a crowded genre, filled with certified classics like Slay The Spire. Even so, there are many games doing interesting things with cards and decks. At first glance, Battle Suit Aces stuns with its anime-inspired visuals, which pull on super robot classics like Gurran Lagann. But its tactical battles, visual-novel storytelling, and Persona-like structure give it serious depth. You can play the demo right now.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Battle Suit Aces Demo Live now!
notes.content:
[b]For the first time EVER, play a demo of Battle Suit Aces right now on Steam.[/b]

Battle Suit Aces is a charming narrative deckbuilder from the team that brought you Battle Chef Brigade. You'll recruit, befriend, and upgrade your mech pilots on a heartfelt hunt for fabled alien superweapons: the Relic Suits. Command them across monster-infested galactic wilds through danger, tragedy, and comedic sci-fi shenanigans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/410d255ceb7f56454cda0013f59d16b0a6ecb8dc.png[/img]

In the demo, you'll:
[list]
[*] meet your lovable crew
[*] recruit from the Hunters Guild and Suitsmith factions
[*] start uncovering the secrets of the Blue Crest relic stuif
[*] tangle with the Carrion Riders
[*] dispatch marauding monsters with your squad of Battle Suits
[*] enjoy bits of a soundtrack your ears will love
[/list]

If you loved Battle Chef Brigade and you want to continue to support our small and passionate team, make sure to play the Battle Suit Aces Demo out NOW for LudoNarraCon (May 1st-5th), wishlist the game here on Steam, and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/trinketstudios]Discord[/url]. 

And if that wasn't enough, check out Carlos Eiene's behind the scenes showcase of the Carrion Riders battle theme:
[previewyoutube=RwK3T60b--M;full][/previewyoutube]

See you on the Bridge! ✨

notes.title: Battle Suit Aces Bulletin 002
notes.content:
Hi Aces! Tom here, Captain of the Starship Trinket. 

For this issue, we'll talk about the basics of designing, concepting, implementing, and illustrating cards. But first, we just released a new trailer in The MIX Fall Showcase! Battle Chef Brigade fans might recognize the narrator!

[b]Check it out below:[/b]

[previewyoutube=zZ_ykynYEGk;full][/previewyoutube]
We're excited to continue to show you what we're working on in updates to come. But for now, let's get back to cards!

[h3]Designing new cards[/h3]
Making a single-player card battler game is very different from making a multiplayer one. Balance and long-term meta evolution are not our goals! Instead, scenarios in Battle Suit Aces are designed around different goals, like setting up the player to feel cleverly powerful and offering surprising combos via guest characters that fit the narrative.

We have an enormous spreadsheet of ability, item, and scenario ideas that we're always adding to. When I start designing a card, I'll often peruse that spreadsheet to see if there are any that fit the story or tone of whatever the card will be. That's happened a lot recently as I worked on some of the end game battles - we finally implemented a bunch of neat abilities that we can now foreshadow or just use earlier in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/08c16e175437ff774475747b589dc2387fd4790f.png[/img]
Once a card has basic abilities in and it feels ok, we get to test our assumptions. Do the Nautilus monster's abilities synergize well with the other sea-inspired cards it'll be paired with? Does it use the right energy type to make it more or less potent? Is it understandable to the player? We'll tweak cards a lot as we play through the game.

At this stage in a card's lifecycle, cards just use placeholder icons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/b6707accaeccfe3aabb222adef538e4df7671840.png[/img]

[h3]Finalizing art[/h3]
At some point, Eric will decide that it's time to add art to the cards. We're focusing on the early-game cards now, but sometimes we want to get a cool monster's abilities into a trailer, so we'll move it to the front of the line and give it at least a rough colored version.

There are a bunch of stages for cards, but they always start with a rough sketch. That's then refined to make sure the pose is strong and the card's icons won't get in the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/f0c4449b08025fad25a6a65a4603f608bcc12c79.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/d4decea1db1ffe4971ca89ed7af8570c171a231b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/6249de6b9260dfd0c4b94c9504ae272325ea8207.gif[/img]

Of course, there are more than just monsters in the game! Pilots in their Battle Suits are the real stars, so they get a corner of the card as well. Here's my favorite Suitsmith, Mirabell. For a long time, we struggled with our desire to make a ton of rich, lovable characters and our excitement over mecha gameplay. Pairing them together and having both on the cards helped us acheive both.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/759ca2074765e9f2fe0be3fc86ae71ee30c99b21.png[/img]
[h3]Integrating FX[/h3]
One of the final steps in designing a card is to integrate some quick effects for its abilities. We've set up a pretty good pipeline for defining different kinds of projectiles (e.g. a beam, a machine gun effect, or guided missiles), impacts, and muzzle flashes. We top that off with some controls to apply gradient colors to the textures. With this pretty small toolset, we can achieve a wide range of effects to really drive home the power behind your mecha's attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/f37c5441003be9ef50042cec7ee035fd68d1ee63.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/2081782bbcd12365f416c2c7f5728dec06ab104f.gif[/img]

See you next time, pilots!
- Tom

notes.title: Battle Suit Aces Bulletin 001
notes.content:
[h3]Heyo! Tom here, Captain of the Starship Trinket. For Battle Chef Brigade, we did regular updates for the Kickstarter. For Battle Suit Aces, we're not doing crowdfunding (thanks [url=https://www.innersloth.com/outersloth/]Outersloth[/url]!), so we're going to share a bit here regularly!

Even though a sci-fi card game might feel very different from a brawler match 3, Battle Suit Aces and Battle Chef Brigade share a lot of DNA. The characters, town/ship, and environments look very different, but they share the positivity, color, and joy that we love to spend time building.

Today, let's explore the USS Zephyr. It's an old Battle Suit Carrier with minimal armaments.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/917e8acd5e7f85fea7a4beb4a2c29c634427e556.gif[/img]

[h3]Thankfully, its lack of firepower, shielding, and handling is offset by its warm, spacious interior.
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/17eb279ba1c135176c1684a85053cbf69728bccd.png[/img]
[i]The mess hall is more than just a place to grab a bite. It's part bar and family room as well.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/b44d6c27b167f3880de908e2ec2e7e465e7398ad.png[/img]
[i]If the Zephyr runs into trouble, the Battle Suits will deploy directly from the enormous Hangar.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/f22d5143c06b024d1c2bb39c2dd47797c50c66d2.png[/img]
[i]When Captain Heathcliff isn't working on a Suit, you might find him taking calls in his quarters.[/i]

[h3]You'll visit many more of the rooms on the Zephyr during your adventure, accessible after each mission.
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/c30d9db3e4c12bb2e6907c2f8de0333f33a96557.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/d3bcaed0194d96794dce4e1db5940a9f3757e634.png[/img]
[i]Yan is usually found in the Garden.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050909/7a7689ea246ea837efae2b4239bf0a022552acd2.png[/img]
[i]And the Zephyr's First Officer, Hanako, can be found on the Bridge.[/i]
[h3]
Thanks for joining us this month, Captains. Keep this channel open for future updates!

- Tom[/h3]
